item.title: Brazil’s Election Defies a Right-Wing Trend, and Trump’s Midterm Attacks Enter a New Phase
item.description:
Plus, can a three-hour documentary lead the box office? 

Here’s what we’re covering:

  • Lula Wins Brazil’s Presidency, in Stunning Blow to Latin America’s Right, by Ana Ionova and Adam B. Ellick
  • Trump’s Election Attacks Enter New Pre-emptive Phase, by Zolan Kanno-Youngs
  • María Corina Machado, Venezuela’s Leading Opposition Figure, Returns Home, by Julie Turkewitz, Edward Wong and Adam Entous
  • A New Level of Threat and Fear Risks Pushing the U.S. and Iran Back to Full War, by David E. Sanger, Julian E. Barnes, Jonathan Swan, Maggie Haberman, Farnaz Fassihi and Eric Schmitt
  • Shiny Glass Skyscrapers Are a Hot Thing. Literally., by Chico Harlan and Zunaira Saieed

Tune in every weekday morning, and tell us what you think at: theheadlines@nytimes.com.
